title: fix(fields,plugin-form): a wizard keeps the file whose upload was still running when Next was pressed (objectui#10180)
body:
Fixes #10180

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

Picking a file on a wizard step, pressing **Next** before its upload settled, then pressing **Create** on the last step before it settled, wrote the record **without the attachment** and reported success.

## The premise, re-measured on `origin/main` 62597c5

Real `FileField`, real form renderer, real react-hook-form; only the upload transport was deferred.

| card / dispatch reading | measured |
|:--|:--|
| the step unmount ends the upload, its settle never lands, the fileId never reaches `formData` | **falsified in its mechanism.** The upload is not aborted, and its settle DOES land. FileField's captured `onChange` is react-hook-form's Controller `onChange`, which in 7.85 re-registers a field it no longer tracks and then writes the value. A Create pressed AFTER the settle stored `attachment: file_123` in both shapes probed: step 1 = the file alone, and step 1 = a typed name + the file, which forces the form's `defaultValues` reset at the step boundary. |
| the record is written without the attachment | **holds, in one timing.** After Next, the final Create read `Create` and was enabled. Pressed before the settle, it stored `{}` / `{"name":"Alice"}`: no attachment, success reported. The unmount released the widget's entry in the uploading scope (the unmount release in `useUploadingScopeReport`), so the objectui#10166 final-commit gate read `false` while the upload was still running. |
| the objectui#10166 pin declines to gate Next | read: the WizardForm row's doc comment in `uploadInFlightSave.test.tsx`. Its sentence "its value never lands in `formData` at all" is the part measured false above. The comment now points at this card's pin. |
| TabbedForm may share the shape | **does not.** TabbedForm's panels are `forceMount`ed (objectui#2959). After switching to tab 2 mid-upload, the file input is still mounted and Save reads `Uploading…`. Nothing is stored mid-upload, and `file_123` is stored after the settle. Not touched. |

## The repair: on the producer side, in `@object-ui/fields`

Landing site: `packages/fields/src/widgets/uploadingScope.tsx`, `FileField.tsx`, `ImageField.tsx`. Why there and not in `WizardForm`: the scope's in-flight entry is bound to the widget's MOUNT, and the upload's lifetime is not. Any host whose body unmounts mid-upload inherits that, and the widget's upload pipeline is the only code that knows when the upload actually ends.

- `useUploadingScopeHold()` is module-internal and **not** exported from the package entry. It returns `hold()`, which marks one upload in flight in the enclosing scope and returns that upload's `release()`.
- FileField's `useFileUploads` and both ImageField upload paths (pick and crop) take the hold when the upload starts. They release it in the `finally`, after `onChange` has handed the value over, whether or not the widget is still mounted.
- The mount-bound report and its unmount release are unchanged. While the widget is mounted, the two entries start and stop together.
- `FileCell` (the GridField line-item cell, same pipeline) deliberately does NOT get the hold. It reports into no scope today, and whether it should is not this card's call (GridField is fenced to objectui#9909).

`WizardForm.tsx` changes one comment only. `Next` is not gated, and nothing new is rendered. On the last step, Create now shows the existing objectui#10166 `Uploading…` label and reason notice until an upload started on an earlier step settles. That is the same answer the gate already gives for an upload on the last step. This is the dispatch's preferred route: the chosen file survives the navigation, and no Next block is added.

## Evidence (at head `fea034b`)

**Acceptance pin, on the stored value.** `packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.nextMidUpload.test.tsx`, `it.each` over `file` and `image`. Step 1 types a name and picks a file through the widget's real input, then Next is pressed mid-upload. The same Create gesture is issued twice. Mid-upload, the row asserts NOTHING was stored, then the `Uploading…` label, the disabled button and the reason. After the settle, it asserts ONE record `{ name: 'Alice', FIELD: 'file_123' }`.

**Producer pin.** `packages/fields/src/widgets/uploadingScope.hold.test.tsx`:
- FileField and ImageField keep the scope uploading after an unmount, until the upload settles.
- A failed upload after an unmount releases the scope (FileField).
- A widget mounted throughout clears the scope on the settle.

**Red on `main` behaviour, green with the fix.** The fix was committed first.

| leg | mutation, proved on disk | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| main behaviour | the three fields files checked out from BASE `62597c5`. For each file the disk blob equals the BASE blob and differs from the HEAD blob. `useUploadingScopeHold` hits on disk: 0 | 5 failed, 2 passed. Both wizard rows fail on the stored value: `expected [ { name: 'Alice', …(2) } ] to deeply equal []`, received `{ attachment: undefined, name: 'Alice', note: undefined }` |
| anchored ablation | `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deletes the hold's `target.report(id, true);`. Anchor count 1 to 0, blob `8b06d7a8f87e` to `427d9827b6c7`, on-disk count read inside the run: 0 | the same 5 failed, 2 passed. The 2 that stay green are the "mounted throughout" rows, which the unchanged mount-bound report covers. That is the predicted direction. |
| restore | `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH` per file | every path's blob equals its HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` is empty, `git status` is empty. Re-run: 7 of 7 green |

`@object-ui/fields` resolves to `packages/fields/src` through the root vitest alias, so the runs measured the source mutation itself. No `dist/` was involved.

| command (repo root, at `fea034b`) | exit |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ packages/fields/` plus the six `packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog*.test.tsx` (the one `onUploadingChange` host: it mounts no scope, so the hold is inert there) | 0: 291 files, 4122 passed, 1 skipped |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check`, each running both of its `tsc` legs. The dependency closure was built first: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build`, exit 0 | 0 |
| `pnpm check:phantom-deps`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:changeset-claims`. The last is report-only; it named one paragraph that mentions `WizardForm.tsx`, the `WizardStepConfig` paragraph of `.changeset/6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`, which I re-read and is still true | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0: 7 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (8 paths) | 0: NOT GOVERNED |
| eslint, narrowed to the 7 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files | 0 errors |

**The lint narrowing is a measurement, not a skip.**
- Population: eslint's own config, `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`; none of the 7 files falls under an `ignores`.
- Files linted: 7, the count from `--format json`.
- Invariance: the resolved config carries no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` (read from `--print-config`). With no type-aware rule, this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

The diff adds 2 warnings, both in `uploadingScope.tsx`, and both are rules the file's existing hooks already trigger (`react-refresh/only-export-components`, `react-hooks/refs`). `lint.yml` deliberately sets no `--max-warnings`. The repo-wide `pnpm lint`, `Build & E2E` and `Build Docs` are CI's runs.

**i18n:** no key is added or changed, so `check:i18n-keys` / `check:i18n-drift` are not owed.

**Clause-② is `no`, and measured.** No symbol is added to or changed in the `@object-ui/fields` entry. In the built `dist/index.d.ts`, `useUploadingScopeHold` has 0 hits, against a control of 1 hit for `useUploadingScope`. The package's `exports` map exposes only `.` and `./style.css`. This is the same status as the module-internal `useUploadingScopeReport` from objectui#10166: 0 hits in the entry, 2 in the module `.d.ts`. The one behaviour change to a published hook: `useUploadingScope().anyUploading` now stays true until an upload started inside the scope has settled. Before, it went false when that upload's widget unmounted.

## Acceptance notes

- **The hold's lifetime.** A hold lasts exactly as long as its upload promise is unsettled. A mounted widget's report already has that limit: a hung upload already keeps a mounted form's Save gated. So this adds no new way to wedge Save. The objectui#10166 unmount-release rationale still applies to the mount-bound entry, and `uploadingScope.tsx` documents it against the hold.
- **Back after Next.** Going back to the step before the upload settles remounts a fresh widget with no spinner, while the wizard's reason notice keeps showing. When the upload settles, the file appears in that widget. That is truthful, if not pretty. A spinner that followed the upload across remounts would be new rendered state, and it is not in this card.
- **Observation, not measured:** `FileCell` (GridField line-item cells) reports into no uploading scope, so a record Save may not wait for a cell upload. My probe did not reach the widget: in the probe harness, a `grid` field rendered as a text input. GridField is fenced to objectui#9909. Carrier: whoever next touches GridField's file cells. 承接者:无.
- **Found while measuring, reported to the seat and not filed here:** a failed upload in ImageField's pick handler has no `catch`. The failure escapes as an unhandled rejection, and the widget renders no message. FileField renders `fields.file.uploadFailed` for the same failure. Probe: a rejecting transport plus one pick gave 1 unhandled rejection ("network down") and no failure text in the DOM.

## Declared deviations

- The wizard acceptance test swaps the upload transport through `vi.mock('@object-ui/providers')`, inheriting the real module and overriding only `useUpload`, instead of mounting `UploadProvider`. `@object-ui/providers` is not a plugin-form dependency, so the direct import failed `check:phantom-deps` and the package's test tsconfig. Declaring the dependency would have touched `packages/plugin-form/package.json` and the lockfile, which are outside the claimed file surface.
